name: infra_conditional_imports
title: Optional dependencies, TYPE_CHECKING imports, a function-local import and an importlib/getattr dispatch
origin: hardening round 2, tester domain-infra: the import shapes every production trainer carries
note: A precision trap with two live false positives. MLV501 fires TWICE at confidence 0.900 (certain) saying `the model model is never moved`, with the evidence line `no .to(device) / .cuda() on any nn.Module in the workspace`, about a file whose line 161 is `model = build_model(args.arch, features=48, classes=6).to(device)`. The trigger is the pairing of two ordinary things: the model is produced by a factory MLView has itself declared dynamic (`dynamic_scope` on train.build_model, lines 75-76), so the receiver of the `.to()` carries no nn.Module type, and the helper's parameter IS annotated `model: nn.Module`, which is what gives the rule a model to talk about in the first place. Deleting the annotation silences the rule; replacing the dispatch with a direct constructor silences it too. Both rows are recorded `acceptable` ONLY so this corpus addition does not turn a shared gate red; forbiddenAfterFix holds the labels they must become. This is the INFRA-02 family (fixed in round 1 by widening the search to the whole workspace) recurring through a different hole. See the domain-infra round-2 report, finding INFRA-R2-10.
stagesObserved: config, data, model, objective, train, eval and deliver present; preprocess absent, which is correct - nothing here transforms features. The `dynamic_scope` diagnostic names build_model and only build_model, which is exactly right.

forbidden.why: the training loader is built with shuffle=True at line 92
the validation loader is built with shuffle=False at line 94
no DataLoader here passes num_workers, and the module ends in `if __name__ == "__main__": main()`
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is at line 114, before the forward at 115
optimizer.step() is called at line 119, after loss.backward() at line 117
the order is zero_grad (114) -> forward (115) -> loss (116) -> backward (117) -> clip (118) -> step (119)
the epoch loss is accumulated as running += loss.item(), a Python float
there is no torch.amp.GradScaler in this workspace; apex_amp is an optional import guarded by `is not None` and is not a GradScaler
clip_grad_norm_ at line 118 sits between the backward at 117 and the step at 119
validate() calls model.eval() at line 127 and model.train() at line 136 on the way out
validate() carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator at line 124
the accuracy comparison at line 133 is on model(features).argmax(dim=1), not on raw logits
neither architecture applies a softmax: both return self.head(...) directly
WideMLP.forward and ResidualMLP.forward both end in nn.Linear and there is no Softmax or LogSoftmax in this file
the device is chosen behind torch.cuda.is_available() at line 157, and the apex branch is additionally guarded by device.type == "cuda"
seed_everything(args.seed) at line 154 calls random.seed, numpy.random.seed, torch.manual_seed and torch.cuda.manual_seed_all, and the loader passes generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(99)
there is no sklearn splitter and no random_split; the cut is a literal index and the training loader passes an explicit generator
both WideMLP.__init__ and ResidualMLP.__init__ call super().__init__() as their first statement, at lines 18 and 35
the residual blocks are built inside nn.ModuleList(...) at line 38, which is exactly the registration this rule asks for
torch.save stores model.state_dict() at line 179, not the module object, and nothing in this workspace calls torch.load

line 161 is `model = build_model(args.arch, features=48, classes=6).to(device)`, and both loops move every batch value to the same `device` before the forward (112-113 and 131-132); there is nothing inconsistent here to report PROMOTED in hardening round 2: finding INFRA-R2-10 is fixed - `r_device._any_model_move` no longer states a workspace-wide negative from a search that an unattributable `.to(...)` left incomplete - so this is a forbidden label like any other.
